rows.content: 33. In the father's notes on the Zohar in our portion, he focuses on what is stated in the Zohar at the end of our portion, that Rabbi Chiya said to Rabbi Yosi a Torah teaching that he had heard from Rabbi Elazar (the son of Rashbi) on the verse "And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, nor will I abhor them to destroy them" – that "to destroy them" should be required, and in practice it is written "to destroy them" lacking a vav:
rows.sourceHebrew: לג. אין די הערות פון טאטן אויפן זהר בפרשתנו שטעלט ער זיך 222 אויף דעם וואס עס שטייט אין זהר סוף פרשתנו 223 אז ר' חייא האט געזאגט לר' יוסי א תורה וואס ער האט געהערט פון רבי אלעזר (בנו של רשב"י) עה"פ 224 "ואף גם זאת בהיותם בארץ אויביהם לא מאסתים ולא געלתים לכלתם" – אז "לכלותם מיבעי לי'" ובפועל שטייט "לכלתם" חסר וי"ו:

rows.content: Now, we wish to connect the matter of the study of Chassidus by telephone with a physical matter of the farbrengen and all its participants, which is a farbrengen on the eve of Lag BaOmer, which takes place in the synagogue and study hall, a place where Torah and prayer are magnified, and within the four cubits of His Holiness, my father-in-law, the Rebbe, the leader of our generation – for the entire house is considered his four cubits [all the more so from the fact that in several laws, the entire city is considered his four cubits] – in which house he performed his service during the last ten years of his life in this world, ten consecutive years, until the day of his passing and his hillula on the tenth of Shevat, at which time he attained a most elevated ascent, similar to the ascent that Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai attained at the time of his passing.
